senses.gloss: this very thing, even this, it is this.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 1:3:24">Y. Dem. I, 22ᵇ</cite> top <he>ה׳ מחלוקת</he> this very thing is controverted.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:51">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ה׳ משום נטילת וכ׳</he> this is because it is an act of killing. Y. Taan. V, 67ᵈ top <he>וה׳ אמר</he> and this he said.

senses.gloss: (= הֵי דָא) which? where? Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56ᵃ top בה׳ אתיתא by which road did you come? Ib. ולא חכים בה׳ and he did not know by which.—
units: Y. Sabb. II, 5ᵃ bot. ה׳ היא which (transgression) is it (that he is guilty of)? Ib. VII, 10ᶜ, a. fr. וה׳ אמרה דא and what (Mishnah, Boraitha) says this (where is your authority)?; Y. Pes. II, 29ᵇ bot. והַיְדָּא.—Contr. וַיְידָּא. Ib. VII, 34ᵇ bot. ו׳ אמר and it is this he said; i.e. in this connection he said it.—לַיְידָּא, v. הַיי.—היידא ל־ (cmp. h. הִנֶּנּוּ) behold, there is.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 2:1:5">Y. Bicc. II, beg. 64ᶜ</cite> <he>והַיְידָּלוֹן חמשים וכ׳</he> (= <he>וה׳ לון</he>) and behold, here are fifty two.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:10">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="E00545"><he>הַלָּזֶה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 37:19">Gen. XXXVII, 19</cite>) <he>הַיְידִּי ליה וכ׳</he> (= <he>היידא הִי</he>) behold, it is himself, he comes carrying his dreams; (Yalk. ib. 141 <he>דיליה</he>, corr. acc.).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 8:1:2">Y. Snh. VIII, beg. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>היי די ליה אב וכ׳</he> behold, he is a father and not a son.
